title: Q-SYS-AGENT-LADDER: SYS-2: code-agent ladder with escalation, a second-model reviewer and a cost log
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** file:foundation/agent_ladder.py
**Status:** open

Owner directive 2026-11-12: a system is an integrated collection of parts, not one worker and a database.

The executor calls one Workers AI model (qwen2.5-coder-32b). QNFO already runs ensemble and cost-optimized routes (qnfo-router, ai.qnfo.org). Build foundation/agent_ladder.py: try the cheapest model, escalate on a failed check or unusable reply, have a different model review the diff before the PR, and append every call's model, tokens and cost to ops/agent-cost.jsonl. The executor uses it in place of call_model.
Paths: foundation/agent_ladder.py, foundation/executor.py, tests/foundation/test_agent_ladder.py.
Acceptance: tests show escalation order, reviewer veto and cost rows; live executor run records its cost rows.

size: L

**Closing probe:** file:foundation/agent_ladder.py exists and its tests pass.
